text: The original renamed helper obtains GetMessageKey and casts it to ImapUid in its partial-fetch/show-deleted/just-expunged branch. Its TODO explicitly defers a real UID lookup. Accepted code later calls UidFromHdr, requires a nonzero result and logs missing/error cases; the full-state invalid sentinel also later becomes zero. Keep that real mapping phase separate from the naming/type-alias change. No expunge, mapping or server test ran.
title: The delete-UID rename keeps an explicit local-key cast for expunged headers
